name: 表示項目の追加・除外と順序制御リスト
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Salesforce field-selection crop as a faithful Japanese localization. The reference is exactly 730x330 pixels (about 2.21:1). Preserve the same compact horizontal composition: two equal bordered white lists side by side, a narrow central column with two small blue transfer arrows, and a narrow reorder-control area at the far right. Do not add a dialog title bar, dimmed backdrop, footer buttons, browser chrome, or content outside this crop.

Use the same small, clean gray sans-serif interface typography, thin gray borders, white interiors, and Salesforce-blue controls. Above the left list show 「利用可能な項目」; above the right list show 「表示項目」. Keep the source's modest padding and row spacing, with six visible rows in each list.

Left list, in exact order: 「取引先 ID」, 「取引先所有者の別名」, 「取引先所有者: 名」, 「取引先所有者: 姓」, 「親取引先」, 「取引先: 取引先ソース」. Right list, in exact order: 「名前」, 「取引先名」, 「電話」, 「メール」, 「役職」, 「取引先責任者の別名」. Preserve the small right-pointing blue arrow beside the left list and left-pointing blue arrow below it, centered in the gutter. At the far right, show the blue up and down reorder arrows aligned with the visible list as in the crop; allow the edge controls to meet or slightly clip at the crop boundary, matching the source.

Keep the field names legible and compact, each in one line. Match the original list widths, narrow central gutter, alignment, and vertical rhythm. No selected-row highlight, checkboxes, extra icons, extra fields, or added labels. Use the supplied crop as the authority for exact structure and spacing.
reviewNotes: Localized six available and six visible fields in source order; preserved side-by-side list geometry, transfer arrows, clipped reorder arrows, spacing, and border. Candidate 1864x843 (2.211:1) vs exact crop 730x330 (2.212:1), about 0.04% ratio difference. Side-by-side comparison inspected.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
